name: Long March 2C
location_str: LC-3 (LC-3/LA-1) @ Xichang Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: The 52nd launch of the year for China's CASC, 622nd all time. It works out to a launch every six days. Long March 2C is on a 44-flight success streak.
slot_b_text: Pogo oscillation is a coupled vibration between a rocket's propulsion system and its structure that can become dangerously unstable.
